description: Blitz fork, line breaking and font loading: the paragraph's font is declared with format("woff2-variations") (Blitz skipped such sources, so the text fell back and collapsed); Chromium's soft wrap opportunities in a narrow paragraph (after the hyphen in 1999-12-31, none inside 1/2 or before -5) and the min-content width they give an inline block. Geometry checks the break opportunities through the min-content width of #date-min; the wrapped paragraph itself is checked by screenshot inspection (the pixel gate averages over the whole viewport).
